title: Midian Gaming Website
description: Responsive website made for real client with timetable, carousel, and social embeds. Hosted on Github Pages

title: StoreAdmin (Full Stack Admin Dashboard)
description: Developed a full-stack admin dashboard for managing customers, products, stores, and sales with complete CRUD functionality.
Built a RESTful API using ASP.NET Core Web API with Entity Framework Core and SQLite, implementing relational data models and validation.
Designed a responsive React frontend with Redux Toolkit for state management and dynamic data handling.
Implemented data relationships, form validation, modal-based create/update flows, and real-time UI updates.

title: CrimeLocator
description: This project aimed to empower users with real-time information about crime activities
in their respective neighbourhoods. Built with a vision to make communities safer and more informed.

title: Soil
description: This application is designed to provide a seamless and efficient user experience
for managing grocery items, user interactions, and purchase processes.
The application utilizes a React frontend, with a backend powered by
Express, Sequelize, Node.js, and MySQL hosted on the cloud.
The application also features Admin site backend powered by apollo-server-express and React for frontend

title: MCBA Internet Banking System
description: Developed a full-stack internet banking web application using ASP.NET Core MVC with a three-tier architecture.
Implemented core banking features including deposits, withdrawals, transfers, transaction history, and scheduled bill payments.
Designed and integrated a relational database using Entity Framework Core with code-first migrations and validation rules.
Built secure authentication, session management, and background processing for automated scheduled payments.

title: Scrabble (C++ Game)
description: This project is a multiplayer text-based Scrabble game built in C++14,
focusing on implementing core game logic and data structures.
It supports features such as tile placement, scoring, turn-based gameplay,
saving and loading game states, and input validation, using vectors for the board
and custom linked lists for managing player hands and tile bags.
